notes.title: 🧀CHEESEART HEAT 🧀- Merch Contest 🖌️Starts NOW!🏆
notes.content: [h3]Hiya Cheesemunchers,[/h3][p]Simon & White G in the house. If you’re like “who the heck is this guy?” - maybe you’ve bumped into my other games like [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/390290/Bulb_Boy/"]this game[/url], [url="https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/poopdie-chapter-one-switch/?srsltid=AfmBOorzS7taY5ZVtOrzMZaFkkS9OYf7JQjUSU-TwyGUmL-2ExMO2-Dn"]this game[/url], and now this game, which has very little time left until its release. Pre-release excitement is growing stronger by the day and I recorded a video to share something really melty that I've been cooking up for a while. [/p][p] [/p][p]So here’s the deal: When I look at Adrian Carmack's [url="https://doomwiki.org/wiki/File:Spider_Mastermind_model.jpg"][u]work[/u][/url] on Doom or Kevin Kilstorm's [url="https://www.blood-wiki.org/index.php/User:Tchernobog/archive/workshop"][u]work[/u][/url] on Blood, I think that's what game development is all about. Uninhibited world-building and letting your imagination run wild. 🌈💣 When I started working on my game, I explored different styles and ultimately went with rubber hose, but I still miss that phase of exploring. So, take note…👂[/p][p][/p][h3][b]I'm announcing a CHEESEART CONTEST.[/b][/h3][p]Wanna learn the details but too lazy to read? Got you! [b]Hit play on the video:[/b] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="VH8gTC1n5Ek;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/4d2c7a0960679ac50e5cdb617770ee8d90fa8a54.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If Bad Cheese sparks anything in your brain, 🧠 don’t overthink it. Just make some cursed art, 👹 [url="https://www.lukasik.art/cheeseart"]toss it my way[/url]. To [b]HONOR CREATORS LIKE YOU[/b], I made these Painmouse figurines and vinyl stickers for the winners! [/p][p][/p][p]Please [u][b]send your works[/b][/u] to my email address (wassup\[at]lukasik.art) and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3094480/images/"]upload them to the Steam Artwork Page[/url]. Deadline’s [b]October 1st[/b], and Gary and I will announce the winners on Halloween. 🎃 [/p][p][/p][p]15 of you cheesy legends will score some merch. 👑 Don’t leave me hanging or I’ll be swimming in stickers. 🧀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/a2d01c26e4f1fe26b7a58e039b3e66e69813fb67.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/d8a91cbca8f3ce2b2f08ba0bfd3d75dbe0896ea3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Big thanks to all the YouTubers already spreading the stink, I mean hype, who made pre-release videos about the game, and  fingers crossed for IGN’s review. Dropping your creation into the world is hype but also kinda nerve-wracking, you know? 😱 [/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, I gotta bounce - still cooking the Release Trailer and smashing bugs. 🐛🪲🐞🦟 I’ll drop another vid for launch day. 📼🚀[/p][p][/p][p][b]And hey.. remember... Stay cheeseful[/b][/p][p]Two Mammals 🦶🦴[/p]

notes.title: Small Start, Big Smell!
notes.content:
[h2]Iya! It’s ya boi Simon & White G - Kraków's kings of the game.
[/h2][p][/p][h3]As a game approaches the release, it's a very exciting time. On one hand, I'm happy that we managed to push this project to the finish line, but on the other, I have a lot of concerns 😰 about how it will be received. [/h3][p][/p][h3]It brings back memories of how it all began...[/h3][h3]
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/98b8f9f968f0960ef90ef03b0a74faa5a50a8551.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Five Days with Daddy [/i](2015) - initial concept from my mini pocket sketchbook [/p][p][/p][p]Around 2015, I started making the first sketches for a survival game in a small notebook. 📓 I considered making the project using modeling clay. The uniqueness of this idea was that in this game we weren't supposed to fight monsters coming at night, pull through the war or endure winter, but simply try to survive with our own parent. For many children, growing up in a dysfunctional homes is like navigating a daily mental minefield. I don't want to go into detail about why this story is important to me, but if you're interested, you can learn more from an interview with Brad Norton from Dexerto [b][u][url="https://www.dexerto.com/gaming/new-game-of-the-week-bad-cheese-3217840/"]here[/url][/u][/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]In 2022, I briefly entertained the idea of creating the game for Oculus VR in shades of green. Back then, it was titled [i]7 Days with Daddy[/i]. You can see the concept art for this version below, along with a video of the prototype made with Łukasz Gratkowski ‘Nixon’ Kot.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/31633b27667b4de69f55642ff1f571b1158b9e88.png"][/img][/p][p]Here's what it looked like during the early tests:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/wQ8MgLj6ISg"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]I should mention that since 2014, Artur and I have been running a two-person studio named Bulbware.  Over the 10 years we worked together, we managed to accomplish many things we are proud of and earned the trust of Felix ‘PewDiePie’ Kjellberg who, since the very beginning, offered us his help and friendship. However, at the beginning of 2024, we decided to part ways - so Artur kept the Bulbware and I ventured into the unknown.[/p][p][/p][p]As a newly minted solodev, I began working on my first project, which I wanted to release under my own name. I revisited my earlier ideas, but this time, I was inspired by my beloved game [i]Bendy and the Ink Machine[/i] and the short animations of the 1920s. The combination of a sweet, cartoonish style with a traumatic story seen from a child's perspective seemed like a very good mix. The first draft in my sketchbook was this drawing: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/830e9bceb5bb833b43f68056d2fbc6fff2801af7.png"][/img][/p][p]In February of 2024, I began intensive work on the prototype with the help of junior coder MegaMarchewa. 🥕[/p][p]
At the time, I was reading a book by Wlad Marhulets (author of the game [i]Darq[/i]), who spoke highly of his publisher.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/f4333e9833585d551c3677e45331e20bc141a065.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I didn't wait long - on the next day, I sent an email and in March I managed to sign a contract! 🤝 Eventually I secured [b]Feardemic[/b] as my partner - a dope publisher specializing in horror games.  You can check out the first prototype video that I pitched behind the closed doors to three companies (namely Devolver Digital, Feardemic and one other):[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Gr9llapEB2Q?si=-NyyAudRinLXMufu"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]I was incredibly happy that, despite the risk and uncertainty, someone trusted me and believed I could create something worthy of the company which published such hits as [i]Darq, Nightmare Reaper, Garten of Banban[/i] and [i]Papetura[/i]. It was time to roll up my sleeves and start to work hard! 🥵[/p][p][/p][p]Since then, I've spent many months drawing strange creatures and devices. When someone asked me "What do you do for work?" I proudly replied - "I’m inventing a monster which swims under a steamboat, that's a cross between a mouse and an eel, and also a mechanism for smelling socks… And what do you do for a living?".[/p][p][/p][p]And so we landed TODAY. The future is unclear, like a mirror smeared with moldy Gouda. 🧀 To avoid stressing too much about the release, long ago I made a certain assumption, which I wanted to share with you. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope that at least one person will play the game, with whom the story will resonate and prove important enough to give them hope for a better tomorrow, on the other side of the Rotten Cheese.[b] This game is for you - my dear human with a heart full of holes like Swiss cheese[/b]. I'm giving you a hug 🤗 and handing you a gamepad, Steam Deck, Nintendo, Xbox, DualSense, or whatever apparatus you prefer…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/e01de7a530815559fa417d8336210747cb9d21c3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you want to see more behind the scenes cheesy art I prepared an artbook that will be available after the release! 🎨[/p][p][/p][p]Out with the hound, but still in the sound.[/p][p][b]Much love from Kraków PL brothas and sistas - Simon & the one and only White G.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Cheesy Games of Keymick
notes.content:
[h2]Cheese freaks, it’s your boy Simon and his right paw, White G, straight outta nerdcaves of Krakow...[/h2][p][/p][h3]Today I wanted to tell you something important about seven-year-old Keymick. [b]He's a real nerd.[/b] He spends most of his free time on his beloved Arita 2600 console…[/h3][p][/p][p]I really like the concept of a game within a game, and a long time ago, while making Bulb Boy in 2015, we envisioned that we'd make a Game Bulb console where you could find a cartridge and play [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1216321816/bulb-boy/posts/901606"][u]Legend of Bulba[/u][/url]. Unfortunately, the Kickstarter didn't quite reach its funding goal (but PewDiePie appeared, so not too bad after all).
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/0e82c72afb512f4006d69bab89a6a66940f5974b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Years later, I managed to revisit the idea and implement it in Bad Cheese (although utilizing different hardware - stationary, not handheld). Initially, I had three different games in mind, but ultimately, only one is playable (who knows - maybe someday there will be a DLC).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/8d1d9b9f5d5dfd312620df82abd77cc0d128997c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Creepong, Sandsnake and Astrosis are each their own unique thing (that is, so far as the concept goes).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/1fcce58fb961896ed27183d3beab5ef7bb9a6312.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Keymick's favorite character from the dark action RPG 'Ratlo' is the Cheese Thief. Unfortunately, Mommsy hid the cartridge, so our mouse can only feast his eyes on the big box...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/a628c6729cd5ae6b81dbdefdb1793e4b35b41c2d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]CREEPONG[/b][/u] is the name of the game featured in Bad Cheese. It's a cheesy mix of 1972's Pong and 2022's Vampire Survivors. In the game, players take on the role of a mouse-pilot, who controls a large ball-bouncing paddle. Their goal is to defeat the evil Baron, and to do so, they must traverse three regions: [u]the Village[/u], [u]the Marshes[/u], and [u]the Cliffs[/u], to finally reach the Castle where [u]the boss reigns[/u]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/02e4bd58bc9ca9251e70ef5312a04c1d0d2932a0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]During the playthrough you gather crystals to get upgrades - with each level you get to choose one of three perks. Each upgrade can be used multiple times - so things can get pretty hectic on screen, making the Arita 1928's console really warm. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/5d7b74d536c751c5ea55adf32c78fc9c7686c08c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Another interesting system made in collaboration with Arita is [u][b]a safe[/b][/u], which hides [u][b]a special Mouses of Galaxy's secret figurine[/b][/u], included with Collector’s Version game package. The safe connects to the console via a special cable and the lock is released only after defeating the final boss. The reward is a figurine commemorating the collaboration between the toy and the game manufacturers. [/p][p]Unfortunately, Keymick hasn't seen secret figurine reveal video, as in 1928 the internet didn't exist...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/1cd48fc1f7e94801f47b8c11f5af1fbbb99d68a1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Illustrated manual for Creepong - a rarity in 1928.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Maybe one of you players will be able to help Keymick get his prized figurine when Bad Cheese is released...[/i]
[/p][p]⚠️ PLEASE REMEMBER TO ASK MR. WALLET! [b]⚠️[/b][/p][p]When you buy Bad Cheese, [b]for the price of one game you get two[/b]! [u][b]BAD CHEESE[/b][/u] + [u][b]CREEPONG[/b][/u]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/a77bb3bd4e41f71fabfcbea8a0fb80537438db7f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And for those who don't like the hassle of playing arcade games, beating Creepong is optional and has no impact on the rest of the story.
[/p][p]Okay, guys, I'm off to cook for my beast. Gary won't eat Royal Canin or anything like that, so I'm cooking him chicken breast with rice and carrots (every other day).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/f7fbb0ab5b6d364d276d9b810bdc901f612c0bec.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Time to bounce and bring the heat… I mean meat. [/p][p][b]- Simon & White G[/b][/p]

notes.title: TayToeGun - Cook, Shoot, Fun
notes.content:
[h2]Sup fam! Simon and White G reporting from the deck of Steamboat Willy (not to confuse it with Willie). [/h2][p][/p][h2]Takin’ y’all on a lil’ tour of that boat setup. And yeah - fries 🍟 are on the menu.[/h2][p][/p][h3]Last time I told you how to do laundry in Bad Cheese, today I'd like to share with you how to make fries. And if you think you know how to make them, believe me, you're wrong. They definitely don't taste as good as TayToe Fries.[/h3][h3]
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/7618600bb0f567dfc3566958efd5670cc1a9839e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Tay Toe Incorporated supports sustainability 🥬 and is therefore seeking solutions that will reduce the production of environmentally harmful batteries, which are not only unreliable in low temperatures but also potentially fire-prone. The company's idea is based on the use of natural, food-based energy sources such as potatoes. [b]🥔 [/b]As we know from physics classes, potatoes have been one of the most readily available energy sources since the time of Columbus. Furthermore, once the charge is depleted, the potato can be consumed as a delicious, low-fat meal. Damn, these fries bussin' like crazy! 😎🍟[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/25e88a6f1ed652fd6a01ee7633484dfe4bdaedde.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]All the concept sketches for Frynator 2000 were really rough (hey, after all even Picasso did some napkin drawing of questionable quality)[/p][p][/p][p]The machine park, manufactured by Tay Toe Inc. in collaboration with environmentalists, is known to customers under the well-known name Frynator 2000™. Take a look at the individual devices in this set, which demonstrate the principle of operation in the form of the voyage of a happy potato:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/30f8cff38333518867ad9980deb4208edb8bb5a2.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Gun™[/u][/b] - Let's start with the fact that if we're going to make fries, we first need to bring potatoes. And this is where things get interesting – we're starting with the wonderful TayToeGun. This unassuming, mid-range gun not only allows you to suck potatoes into the storage tank, but also shoots them with great force. A potato counter allows the gun operator to quickly check the number of rounds. This addition was made in one of the latest iterations of this model.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/38f66c8dc655678297c940a5934b9d8b6cfc482e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Sockets™[/u][/b] - a socket equipped with four copper tips, allowing you to insert a potato and begin the process of transferring power to the electrical grid. The socket is manufactured for various markets in 120 and 230 volts and 60 and 50 Hz frequencies. Four wall plugs are included. Mount out of reach of children. ⚡[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/baa121a0e9de11d04dd36df862572216042f340b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Peeler™[/u][/b] - an industrial peeler powered by three potatoes, equipped with a chute with a mechanical information panel. 3 potatoes required for trouble-free use. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Slicer™[/u][/b] - industrial guillotine-style slicer. Powered by 4 potatoes. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Fryer™[/u][/b] - high-capacity baking cabinet with a three-potato igniter and a dual LPG cylinder. It features a floor-mounted gas valve, ensuring the cook is at a safe distance from the cabinet and won't be burned while preparing the delicacies.💥🔥 [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Packer™[/u][/b] - industrial self-packing box with a counter allowing for precise checking and placement of the desired number of fries in the package. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]TayToe Generator™[/u][/b] - high-performance 8500-watt generator. Requires 8 potatoes but provides exceptionally long operating times. ⏱️ [/p][p][/p][p][b]🥔 REMEMBER TO PURCHASE ALL DEVICES FROM AN AUTHORIZED TAY TOE INCORPORATED DEALER – OTHERWISE, YOU WILL VOID THE WARRANTY. 🥔[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/df45e8628eca1ea26fd24be1d3526dc54212e38a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In my game, you'll have the chance to use all the devices and not only try the fries yourself, but also treat your whole family. Nomnomnom! [/p][p][/p][p]Oh! If a dangerous demon like a Puffermouse 🐡 appears during gameplay, remember that the TayToe Gun is not only useful for preparing a nutritious meal, but also as an effective self-defense tool.
[/p][p]I'd write more, but I'm tired of sitting at the computer, and my best ideas come to me during walks. So I’m hoppin’ in the yellow beast, White G on the leash, time to ditch the desk and step out for some fresh air. [/p][p]
[b]Peace out, Simon & White G[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/2a48ce08b2fdfe832021079dc370138285d2a60e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: SockNose Systems Ltd. presents: A Fragrant Revolution in Sock Sorting
notes.content:
[h2]Simon & G in the cut - chillin’ hard, barkin’ louder!
[/h2][p][/p][h3]One of the things I appreciate about being an indie gamedev is the ability to create everyday devices that aren't limited by production requirements or manufacturing costs. Each such device can be any size, consist of an absurd number of parts, and just has to make sense within the created world. [/h3][p][/p][p]One example of such devices is the Grab Pack from the Poppy Playtime, series which I really like. Interestingly in this case, the dynamic worked in the opposite direction, because after seeing them in the game, players actually started creating their own Grab Packs. And they say games don't influence reality. No duh![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/a3fd7bd718ad7aabe0b6b00b9f31abfa8cf1c8b5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p](Some examples of YouTubers showing-off their Grab Packs - I don’t own copyright to Grab Pack nor the YouTubers)
[/p][p]Now back to [u][b]Bad Cheese[/b][/u]. When I was creating a level set in a basement where Keymick has to do laundry before his dad gets home, the idea of sorting socks immediately came to mind. An invention should be a necessity as we all know the hassle of checking which socks are clean and which are smelly, especially when someone mixes them. If there's no dirt visible, the sorting process can be very unpleasant for the sorter, particularly if the sock turns out to be stinky.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/b631ff551b40e904bfa64c5fcdb09f241488d296.png"][/img][/p][p](SockNose early concept art)
[/p][p]Thus came the hero. [b]SockNose Systems Limited[/b], a fictional household appliance company. Their flagship invention is the [u][b]SockNose[/b][/u], a patented sock sorter that separates clean socks from dirty ones. To effectively use the SockNose system, you need to purchase a complete set of machines, listed below:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/06423fb7b0fbb5dfc421bfbb7715b6d0cde958de.png"][/img][/p][p][b]SockNose™[/b] - a flagship, ingenious device that automatically shuts off if, for example, a stray dirty item appears in the basket of clean socks. Furthermore, the device allows the device to be sucked into a tube that uses air to push the laundry further into the machine park.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/2e00a2a07df96db59dc3b59dd12b098fc4af793c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]SockCannon™[/b] - why carry a heavy laundry basket when you can sit comfortably in the rotating turret and shoot socks into the washing machine or onto a drying line? It's also great for combating voracious Sockmoths.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SockMachine™[/b] - a washing machine with a very large capacity and washing speed. A well-marked large button allows you to fire a sock to start the washing. Why walk when you can shoot?[/p][p][/p][p][b]SockNose Control Box™[/b] - not sure if you can start washing? One glance at the control panel is enough!
[/p][p][b]SockVent™[/b] - a sealed tube system that lets you to toss dirty laundry without having to walk around the house - it will fall directly into the laundry room. It also perfectly isolates odor-prone air.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/521dcef8f7bd67bc1dd1f28fd441519f7583e87a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]SockNose Panel™ [/b]- an intuitive control panel for controlling the SockNose. A lever switches the nose between clean and dirty socks, and the "Sniff" button activates the (you guessed it) sniffing function.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/602505f85cba9ba172173cfe2552c361ce02137a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p](In the attached example, we see that the SockLock has been activated. The door remains closed, and a synthesizer voice announces the contamination)
[/p][p][b]SockLock™[/b] - a system that allows you to tightly close the door if the sensors detect an unpleasant odor in the room. In the case of unforeseen events, this keeps the air in the rest of the house clean until the unpleasant smell is resolved.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🐽🐽🐽 REMEMBER TO PURCHASE ALL DEVICES FROM AN AUTHORIZED SOCKNOSE SYSTEM LTD. DEALER - OTHERWISE, YOU WILL VOID THE WARRANTY 🐽🐽🐽[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/6dc016f2290698785b5a88acf7c831f210c724e3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p](In the attached example, we can see that the container for smelly socks is full, while the container for clean socks is empty. The device remains in the neutral position)[/p][p][/p][p]You can encounter all of these devices in the third stage of the game - the basement. I hope at least one of the inventions piqued your interest and you'd like to have one in your home.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/701fd11418536be493aed75b95e9a0f24841db1f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p](SockNose Sytems operation diagrams - early concepts)[/p][p][/p][p]That's probably all for today, but I have a feeling I'll think of something else soon and share it with you! Hopefully, after the game's release someone will dare to construct a SockNose in real life…[/p][p][/p][p][b]Off the grid, still the realest - peace out,
Simon & White G.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Campfire’s Burning. Cheese Is Turning.
notes.content:
[h3]Iya, Simon here! [/h3][h3]I wanted to let you know that the main platform where I've been spending my video game time lately is Steam Deck. 🕹️ [/h3][h3]That's why I've been testing the game mainly on Valve’s apparatus, and I can confirm that [b][u]Bad Cheese runs well on Deck[/u][/b]. I'm not sure when we'll get the "Steam Deck Verified" badge, but you can rest assured that you shouldn't be disappointed.[/h3][p][/p][p](Obviously my dear colleagues from Feardemic 🫀 make sure that the cheese flows smoothly on all other platforms.)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/e85c832f20e304adb9d8f4cb079a6f181159679d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]For those who've read this far, I wanted to reveal what crazy devices you'll soon be holding in your mouse hands:[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/0a0e51b747a21dec418961004a4cbc50e9e8926b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]And what can you look forward to?[/h3][h3]Some of the Game Features (100% Cheese-Certified):[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]🧀 Dirt Zapper™ - A state-of-the-art shoe-cleaning device powered by cheese-scented static.Finally, a way to remove grime from boots and have some Quake-like fun at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]🧀 Sock Cannon™ - Fires filthy socks directly into washing machines with tactical precision. Perfect for obliterating the airborne menace known as Sockmoths – bloodthirsty moths with a taste for cotton....[/p][/*][*][p]🧀 TayToeGun™ - Potatoes: humble carbs, deadly ammo. Doubles as a power source, snack, and demon-annihilation unit.
Warning: may contain Puffermouse parts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/ad50a3831e23f6715a5156e06a03f96a5c32674f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]And of course, there's more in the game. But I don't want to spoil too much (cheese).🪤[/h3][p]
In any case, I'm incredibly happy that so many people are looking forward to the game. 👀👀👀 [/p][p]This last pre-release period is exceptionally intense for us. Before the release, I'm asking myself a lot of questions and I don't know what the future holds.😰[/p][p]Gary, however, is trying to reassure me and assures me that everything will be okay.[/p][p]The porting of the game is really nearing its final stages, and I hope to be able to share a specific release date with you soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]Much love from Kraków, Poland[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/f2ab21964455592b772d653dca4b141313318028.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]P.S.[/h3][h3]Please remember that you can play [u][b]Bad Cheese Demo[/b][/u] on the go right now![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3374350/Bad_Cheese_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cheesevlog #3 - Mouse Demons
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_-_jCoZ8Xgk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Hello Cheese Friends![/h1]

[h3]Long time, no brie!

The trilogy of Bad Cheese devlogs concludes with a new video by Simon Lukasik, where he discusses Mouse Demons![/h3]

As he says, this is the last devlog. Simon, and his trusty companion Gary, are creating a game called Bad Cheese. Today he wanted to talk about a different kind of monsters. 

Keymick, as the protagonist, has to confront not only his father, but also his own internal mouse demons, whose psychological manifestations will haunt players during the game.
Our plump hero is plagued by three types of mouse demons...

[h3][b]Puffermouse[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/48359a33db052f4de192af847f21b7900fa7cdbd.gif[/img]

A flying demon inspired by a pufferfish. He tempts with sausages and chips, but really wants to grind his victims with his sharp teeth.

[h3][b]Self-Hate Mouse[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/3e041b96ace396714c32da282489b3fd648894bb.gif[/img]

He resembles a pelican and likes to whisper unpleasant things. He has a drooping mouth from which disgusting centipedes fall out. You will meet him in the demo, which you will be able to play in February.

[h3][b]Pain Mouse[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/d81e2e7ae8cda222e0bd0b53664a6dbec49fc062.gif[/img]

Inspired by Światowid, a pagan god who was worshiped in Poland before Christianity. This swirling pile of meat constantly attacks us with meaty fear that can consume us to the point of complete madness. He also creates Children of Fear, which Simon would like not to show you, so as not to spoil the fun.
And those are all the monsters he wanted to talk about today!

[i]Words from Simon:[/i]
"I wanted to thank you right away for all the videos you've made about my game. In particular, AlphaBetaGamer and DomPlays, who made me almost choke on my cheese with laughter, and least but not least...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/7541e180ba8e41ca7f210e139d6a99114a2bff16.gif[/img]

We've finished all the levels for the game and are currently in the beauty pass and testing phase. At the beginning of February, all of you will have the opportunity to play a demo of my game and I'd love to hear what you think about it. You can find a link to the card on Steam below and Playstation store in [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012988]here[/url]. Console ports are also planned."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094480/Bad_Cheese/

And that’s about it, thank you for following Bad Cheese throughout this production of Expired Dairy Product (as Grogg said).

[b]Please Stay Cheeseful! 🧀[/b]

notes.title: Cheesevlog #2 - Eggdaddy
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ffzf4RiNpmE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Hello Cheese Slices![/h1]

[h3]Did you miss us?

Once again, we come to you with a new cheesevlog, made by the creator of Bad Cheese, [b]Simon Lukasik[/b]. Today, let's talk about the Eggdaddy.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/01b4ba883ae9b2bf090304ec41aec83f71e0dd03.gif[/img]

In the game Simon's making, [b]Bad Cheese[/b], the protagonist can meet his dad in various incarnations (see previous cheesevlog). Today we'll talk about another daddy character, [b]Eggdaddy[/b], who was inspired by the 1933 film “Alice in Wonderland”.

At some point in the game, the player accidentally wakes up Daddy and he starts patrolling the bathroom looking for the source of the noise. His body takes the form of an egg, which rolls around patrolling the tiled corridors. Here you can see the first sketches of what Daddy Egg looked like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/7c260bb5ba74b60bb9566bb983dc9511b8357017.gif[/img]

If Daddy sees the player, he starts shooting with egg goo. If we get hit, our movement will be greatly slowed, but we still have a chance to free ourselves. Unfortunately, if Daddy is faster, we will die, pecked by the [b]scary chick that is inside the egg[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/40c948eb46f61efa81e570e89dce047424e6afb8.gif[/img]

The horror is increased by the egg waste hanging everywhere and the screaming egg faces. In this sequence, we will succeed if the mouse is not caught and we manage to get to the toilet.

Finally, Gary and Simon would like to thank you very much for your support and also show you the special button they received. Want to see it? Watch the devlog!

Thanks for joining us and don't forget to wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094480/Bad_Cheese/

Remember to pet your dogs everyday and...
[b]Stay cheeseful! 🧀[/b]

notes.title: Cheesevlog #1 - Daddy the Longneck
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GJ3pU_2aNQ4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Hello Cheese Slices![/h1]

[h3]Cheesed to meet you again - this time, in our first official [strike]devlog[/strike] cheesevlog!

Join the creator of Bad Cheese, [b]Simon Lukasik[/b] (and his trusty companion, Gary) to learn more about the game making process![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/f1b3810dc2710f8bf6c1f05098de4c043b1e42ca.gif[/img]

You may have never heard of it, but [b]Bad Cheese[/b] is a [b]psychological horror[/b] seen from the perspective of a seven-year-old mouse suffering from compulsive eating disorder. 

The child's perception is disturbed by high levels of fear, which intensifies during the game. This causes the kid to see his daddy changing his physical appearance depending on where we are in the story.
The version Simon talks about in his video is called [b]Daddy the Longneck[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/dae32c8157f38b00150195592eebed5b00b19319.gif[/img]

Here is one of [b]the first concept sketches of Daddy[/b], in a sketchbook Simon usually carries with him. This is what the first pencil drawing looked like, and the next image is what it looked like when made in Photoshop.

If you're wondering how the creature was made, [b]it consists of sprites[/b], i.e. flat objects that turn towards the camera, and a cable that is responsible for the neck. Everything is put together in Unreal Engine 5 with the help of Krystian, who supports Simon on this fromage adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/a8878e59f7733dea29f9a9386d8bf13527898455.gif[/img]

When you walk around the character, the drawings change to versions from the front, side or back according to the image that you can see here. 

Without further ado, let's see how it all looks together when we place it in the game and apply some cheddary filters that remind us of the 1920s. We walk around the level a bit here... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257683/1af8ee30ca0319481d2eaec393aa63a367d984d8.gif[/img]

Fancy! It is worth adding that when we look at various elements of the environment or have a jumpscare, we see the creatures in a much more realistic and disgusting version, which can stimulate our imagination. Yes, Simon was inspired here by a certain cartoon about a cheerful chef.

We hope you liked the video and the cheesevlog, and we remind you that you can already add Bad Cheese to your wishlist on Steam. 🧀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094480/Bad_Cheese/

Thanks and remember… 
[b]Stay cheeseful! 🧀[/b]
